name: get-or-create
prompt: Several callers implement get-or-create by calling Get then Create, which is racy: two callers can both miss and both create. Add func (s *Store) GetOrCreate(id, user string) (Session, bool) to session.go. It must be ATOMIC (one lock acquisition): if a live session with id exists, return it and false (wasCreated); otherwise create it with the caller's user and return it with true. An expired session is replaced and true is returned. Do not implement this by calling Get and Create; do the lookup and insert inside a single lock scope.
